summary: Wrote dft/dft_plan.md with all six sections (test strategy, scan approach, test pins, coverage method, memory test approach, open-flow limitations). Plan only: no scan inserted, no tool run, no coverage number claimed.
assumptions: Phase 0 scope only: no commercial tools.
Pre-layout slack figures from reports/synth_tool.json are used only as context for later scan timing checks.
Scan insertion places the scan mux at the flop so shift data is not gated by the synchronous reset; to be confirmed by a real tool.
Single mux-scan chain of the 8 count flops using sky130_fd_sc_hd scan flops is the intended Phase 1+ style.
open_issues: Coverage targets can only be measured in Phase 1+ with ATPG tools.
Scan pins (scan_en, scan_in, scan_out) are not in spec.yaml and spec marks scan/DFT insertion out of scope; adding or sharing pins needs human G1 decision.
Sharing count[7] as scan_out needs review against REQ-012.
Worst pre-layout hold slack is small (0.077 ns at nom_ff_n40C_1v95); scan hops may need hold fixing once scan is inserted.

self_assessment.reason: Document is plan-only, covers all six required sections, makes no coverage claim; correctness of tool-specific assumptions is unverified until Phase 1+.
